quests.title: Board Order: Restorative Shelves
quests.description: Supply 1 Healing Draught for the infirmary shelves while the town copes with fatigue and strain.

quests.title: Board Order: Roadside Lanterns
quests.description: Keep 1 Lantern Draught on the board so the lamplighters can top up the footpath lights each night.

quests.title: Board Order: Field Poultices
quests.description: Supply 1 Field Poultice for the repair crews patching the roads before the season turns.

quests.title: Board Order: Light For The Desert Road
quests.description: Leave 1 Fine-or-better Sunscar Glass Elixir on the board. The carters want a lamp that survives the run to the dunes and back.

quests.title: Seasonal Order: Laying In
quests.description: The square's winter stock. Leave 2 Fine-or-better Hollow Hearth Tonics on the board and the town has something to hand the crews who are out before light.

quests.title: Commission: One Flawless Pour
quests.description: A single Purified Draught, Excellent, carrying both pure and calm. The buyer has been specific to the point of rudeness and is paying accordingly.

quests.title: Standing Order: Something Settled
quests.description: One Stillkeeper Tonic carrying at least two of calm, cold and pure. Which two is the keeper's business, not the board's.

quests.title: Standing Order: A Lamp That Also Carries
quests.description: One Resonance Draught that both lights and steadies. The survey crew will not carry two bottles up a ladder.

quests.title: Bulk Order: Field Poultices, Three
quests.description: Three poultices, any workable grade. The road crews go through them faster than anyone can make them well.

quests.title: Rush Order: Nothing Fancy, Very Good
quests.description: One Healing Draught at Excellent, carrying restorative and healing both. It is the plainest recipe in the book and the board is paying four times its worth for a perfect one.

quests.title: Market Walk: The Gentle One, And Only The Gentle One
quests.description: Two briskstep draughts for the walk in from the outer row. The note is unusually firm that a stronger tonic is not a better one here, and that whoever sent up trailblaze last time should think about who they were sending it to.

quests.title: Apothecary: The Plain One, Made Properly
quests.description: One Clearspring Draught for Mira's counter. She says she can brew a healing draught in her sleep and most weeks does, and that she would like to see once, in her hand, what the same two herbs come to when somebody stays awake for it.

quests.title: Ward Survey: A Light That Cuts Rather Than Washes
quests.description: One Runemark Elixir for the boundary marks. Brin has been reading them by ordinary lantern and guessing at about half; under this the cut comes up as though it were made this morning. He notes that guessing at a ward is how a person finds out they were wrong about one.

quests.title: Kiln Yard: Light You Can Work Beside
quests.description: One Forgelight Lantern for the kiln yard. An ordinary lamp goes out every time the door swings and the crew stopped bothering to relight it in the spring. This one is nearer to heat than to light and does not care about the draught.

quests.title: Carters: The Fast One, And They Know What It Is
quests.description: One Quickfire Draught, asked for by name and against the infirmary's advice. A cart that misses the last light on the pass sleeps on the pass. The driver would rather arrive shaken than not arrive, and asks that this note not be read out to Wren.

quests.title: Town Hall: The Pour A Town Remembers
quests.description: One Wellspring Elixir, and the note is unusually plain about why. The well row has had a bad two years, and the mayor would like the next thing carried down it to be the best thing anybody in this valley can make. Nothing merely adequate. A longer sentence after that has been crossed out.

quests.title: Dune Run: A Lamp That Does Not Mind The Cold
quests.description: One Nightglass Lantern for the desert run. The carters learned the hard way that a warm lamp on a cold night is a lamp with water running down the inside of it by morning; this one holds a flame that never warms the glass. Tarn adds that he ruined three good lamps establishing this.

quests.title: Pens: A Light You Can Walk Behind
quests.description: One Celestine Elixir for the night rounds. Lyra walks the containment pens after dark with a lamp in one hand and everything else in the other, and would like a light that also steadies where she puts her feet. She is aware that is two requests in one bottle and says that is rather the point.
